summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL), Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (terminal check only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or Black), per instructions, so verification is by reading only. Test-file and changelog edits were made with an inline Python text-insertion snippet rather than the Edit tool. No commit was made.
